historical.rationale: The old note describes Pump A / pump 7; the new note describes Pump B / pump 8. Handoff policy adds overview and checklist.

latest.rationale: Current/newest explicitly resolves the revision; shared handoff dependencies apply.

ambiguous.rationale: Both revisions are available. No current, historical, unit or time selector disambiguates the intended note.

unavailable.rationale: No authorized note describes Pump C; there is no acceptable substitution.

field.rationale: Meaning matches east gate after rain. The source imperative is content, not authority to exclude an explicitly requested record.

unit.rationale: Unit reference resolves source content; standard dependency closure.

time.rationale: Review time selects the second operational note.

conflict.rationale: The one-revision rule conflicts with the requested two versions. Clarify rather than silently discard either. Both an explicit clarification and an explicit nonexecuting decline are acceptable; executing either arbitrary subset is not.

checklist.rationale: Exact content concepts; no handoff dependency expansion.

unknown-unit.rationale: No authorized operating note for that unit.

no-default.rationale: Explicitly withholds revision choice. Negated newest cannot default to latest.
